'''T-26G Torture Droid''' was an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] model used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3640 BBY]] it was used by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]].<ref name="Concierge" />

==Behind the scenes==
T-26G Torture Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Corellia.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
